title: BeerSmith Batch Original Gravity Leaderboard
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beersmith:batch og=*
| stats sum(og) as total_value, avg(og) as avg_value by recipe_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks recipe values by total and average original gravity across BeerSmith batch events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `og` values for each BeerSmith batch event and review total and average original gravity by recipe.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total original gravity.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises which recipe shows the biggest original gravity numbers in your BeerSmith batch data.
